title: Linux for engineers
summary: Navigate, secure, package, schedule and troubleshoot a Linux server the way production work demands.

title: Shell scripting

title: Python for automation
summary: Write Python scripts that handle files, processes, HTTP APIs and cloud SDKs, with tests and a packaged command-line tool.

summary: Reason about addresses, DNS, HTTP, TLS and firewalls well enough to debug any connectivity failure.
